reason: Lint: Canvas's menu-open framing (applyInitialView) is an effect event, called only from the swap re-fit effect, so the two refs it was read through (the phone flag and the function itself, both written during render: react/refs at Canvas:238 and :272) are gone. Four new template-load-viewport tests pin the framing first: on a desktop it lands once the swap settles with no Controls inset; on a phone it keeps the 44 px Controls rail inset; with animation frames held and released it lands; and a camera the user wheels before it lands is kept and the framing does not run (the rule #698 kept for a share link's fit). Each of the last two kinds was seen to fail on a deliberately broken copy (the phone inset dropped; the user-move check skipped). npm run lint fails above 66 warnings (was 68). #625 item 5.
